news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Steel Hub Ka Vikaas
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne desh ke pramukh udyogik samuhon ke saath MoU par hastakshar kiye hain, jiske tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga
Is nivesh se Bihar mein steel, textile aur nuclear energy sector ko badhava milega
Bihar sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se Mahashakti Group ke saath sahyog kiya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Sarkar Ki Janseva Aur Vikas Ki Prathmikta
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne kaha hai ki Bihar sarkar ki prathmikta janseva aur vikas hai
Sarkar ne vikas yojanaon par vishesh dhyan de rahi hai, jisse rajya ka samagra vikas ho sake
Mukhyamantri ne adhikariyon ko vikas karyon mein tezi lane ke liye nirdesh diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Parivahan Vikas Ka Marg
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne Nasiriganj-Panapur nishulk stimer ferry seva ka shubharabh kiya hai
Is se yatriyon ko suvidha hogi aur arthik gatividhiyon ko bhi badhava milega
Sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se parivahan vikas par dhyan diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein AI Aur Digital Takneek Ka Upyog
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne kaha hai ki AI aur digital takneek ka upyog vidhayakon aur visheshagyon ke kshamta vikas ke liye kiya jayega
Is se unki karyakshamta badhegi aur ve adhik prabhavi dhang se kaam kar payenge
Sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se takneek shiksha par dhyan diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Tourism Vikas Ka Avsar
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne kaha hai ki Bihar mein naye tourism vikas ka avsar hai
Sarkar ne vishesh roop se Maa Mudeshwari, Bodh Gaya, SultanGanj aur Mandar jaise aitihasik sthalon ka vikas karne ka nirnay liya hai
Is se pariyatan ko badhava milega aur arthik vikas bhi hoga

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein JP Ganga Path Ka Vikas
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne JP Ganga Path ka vikas karne ka nirnay liya hai
Is project ke tahat 65 kilometer ganga channel ka vikas kiya jayega
Sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se parivahan vikas par dhyan diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Udyogik Nivesh Ka Avsar
bullets: Bihar sarkar ne naye udyogik nivesh ka avsar pradaan kiya hai
Is ke tahat 51600 karod rupye ka nivesh hoga, jisse arthik vikas ko badhava milega
Sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se udyog vikas par dhyan diya hai

news_cards.title: Bihar Mein Naye Karyakramon Ka Shubharabh
bullets: Mukhyamantri ne naye karyakramon ka shubharabh kiya hai
Is ke tahat janseva aur vikas par vishesh dhyan diya jayega
Sarkar ne is project ke liye vishesh roop se janseva par dhyan diya hai
